description: Delta DVP series PLCs. The map holds the first device of each Modbus block; the others follow from the formulas in the notes.
notes: A PLC has no fixed list of registers: what you read is the program's own devices. Only the first device of each block is listed here; a tool or user derives the rest by counting from it.

Address of device n (wire address, hex): S 0x0000+n; X 0x0400+n; Y 0x0500+n; T 0x0600+n (contact as coil, value as holding); M0-M1535 0x0800+n; M1536-M4095 0xB000+(n-1536); C0-C199 0x0E00+n (contact as coil, value as holding); C200-C255 contact 0x0EC8+(n-200), 32-bit value 0x0700+2*(n-200); D0-D4095 0x1000+n; D4096-D9999 0x9000+(n-4096).

X and Y numbers are octal (X0-X7, X10-X17...): convert the octal number to decimal before adding it to the base. The spreadsheet supplied with the request numbers Y after Y37 in decimal, which does not match the manual, so the manual was followed.

Reading with FC01/FC02/FC03 and writing with FC05/FC06/FC15/FC16 are supported. The decimal numbers in Delta's tables (X0 = 101025, Y0 = 001281, D0 = 404097) are the same locations in Modicon notation.

Factory serial format is 9600 bps, 7 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit, in ASCII mode, station 1. RTU mode (8 data bits) is selected by the PLC program, so adjust databits when you switch. Not all models have both ports.

registers.name: X0
registers.description: First digital input. X is octal: X7 is followed by X10, so Xn is at 0x0400 + the octal number read as a plain count.

registers.name: Y0
registers.description: First digital output. Y is octal like X.

registers.name: S0
registers.description: First step relay; S0 to S1023 follow one after the other.

registers.name: T0 contact
registers.description: Contact of timer T0; T0 to T255 follow one after the other.

registers.name: T0 current value
registers.description: Current value of timer T0 (16-bit); T255 is at 0x06FF.

registers.name: M0
registers.description: First auxiliary relay; M0 to M1535 run from 0x0800 to 0x0DFF.

registers.name: M1536
registers.description: M1536 to M4095 are in a separate block, from 0xB000 to 0xB9FF.

registers.name: C0 contact
registers.description: Contact of 16-bit counter C0; C0 to C199 run from 0x0E00 to 0x0EC7.

registers.name: C0 current value
registers.description: Current value of 16-bit counter C0; C199 is at 0x0EC7.

registers.name: C200 contact
registers.description: Contact of 32-bit counter C200; C200 to C255 run from 0x0EC8 to 0x0EFF.

registers.name: C200 current value
registers.description: Current value of 32-bit counter C200, two registers each; C201 is at 0x0702 and C255 at 0x076E.

registers.name: D0
registers.description: First data register; D0 to D4095 run from 0x1000 to 0x1FFF.

registers.name: D4096
registers.description: D4096 to D9999 are in a separate block starting at 0x9000. Models with fewer data registers stop earlier.

registers.name: COM1 (RS-232) communication format
registers.description: Special register D1036: speed and format of COM1. Written by the PLC program or WPLSoft, not normally changed over Modbus.

registers.name: COM2 (RS-485) communication format
registers.description: Special register D1120: speed and format of COM2.

registers.name: Communication address
registers.description: Special register D1121: the station address used on COM1 and COM2.
